text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even without Hokko Tarumae, the race was 
immensely thrilling. And then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the run, her close 
Umamusume friends came rushing over as 
well.
Rickey-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The race was wonderful! We were cheering 
for you with all our hearts!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, pure guts and power running! That 
really screamed, "Copano Rickey is here!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan, Dia-chan, you came to watch!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That bold, spirited run! Today was 
truly a Rickey Festival!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What do you say? Should we just stay on 
the track and sing right here?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, outside of a Winning Live!? I'm not 
gonna sing~. People don't normally do 
that, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? If they have the spirit 
of enka, I'm sure they'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I'm thinking I'll pull it off someday, 
too! Maybe Dad will praise me then!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, oh Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Kita-chan really loves her 
father, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well, I ran with a similar feeling today 
too, though.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Today is an important day for Papa. 
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday! ☆ Since it's a special 
day, I thought I'd add a little flair with 
some flowers!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That might have been the reason why there 
was even more power than usual behind 
Copano Rickey's running.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, I gave it my all, and the race 
seemed just as thrilling as usual, but—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the force field was definitely a 
bit off. Feng Shui never lies.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, only in the direction of Kan is the 
Qi failing to rise. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—North. The direction where Tomakomai 
lies.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If Tarumae isn't running, the folks back 
in Tomakomai just can't get fully hyped 
up. It's just how it is.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Please, Tarumae. Come back soon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"So, Trainer. About our next race—do you 
have anything in mind?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, in a race Tarumae is sure to enter.

Yeah, in a race Tarumae will definitely 
enter.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Will it really come out? Where?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One of the biggest races held at Ohi 
Racecourse in June. Namely—
choice_data_list:
I think they'll be aiming for the Teio 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"The Teio Sho... That's right. There's no 
way Tarumae wouldn't aim for that."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure—! This time without 
fail!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A showdown with Hokko Tarumae was indeed 
what the fans were longing for, and the 
best way to prove the power of feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae, I'm setting my sights on the Teio 
Sho. Right now, I bet you are too—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"We're aiming for the same place, right? 
Let's race together just the two of us 
once more!"
